Subject: Order Form - final commercial clarifications, ticketing and tax evidence

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attaching our suggested redline (Redwood_OrderForm_TG_v1_redline.pdf) with the following items we'd like final confirmation on before I send the clean copy to DocuSign: 

1) Invoicing entity and PO flow: TerraGrid has indicated payments will come from TerraGrid Inc. (US). Please confirm the AP contact and whether a PO will be raised for each invoice or a single standing PO for the tranche. If TerraGrid requires invoices billed to a different legal entity, let us know the exact remit-to name and tax ID.

2) Net terms: Our standard is Net 30 but the team approved Net 45 for this pilot. Confirm that Net 45 is acceptable and whether TerraGrid needs any pre-authorization or milestone acceptance prior to payment.

3) Minimum commit phasing: The redline preserves the 12-month minimum commit but proposes quarterly invoice tranches (25% upfront, then 25% at months 4, 7, 10). If that cadence doesn't match your internal forecasting we can do a 50/50 split with amended milestone dates.

4) VAT / withholding / tax evidence: We attached a short tax evidence matrix (Redwood_tax_evidence_matrix.xlsx). For EU/Australia customers we usually need a W-9 or local VAT registration certificate. Please confirm what TerraGrid can provide so we include the right exhibit.

5) Ticketing & escalation SLO reference: We added a short clause linking to the support SLA (Support Appendix A) and a contact for P1 escalation. If your platform team wants a separate SSO-only channel, flag that now.

If you can confirm items 1–4 this afternoon, I’ll convert to a clean order form and route to DocuSign with the agreed Net 45 and the invoice cadence noted.

Attachments: Redwood_OrderForm_TG_v1_redline.pdf (redline), Redwood_tax_evidence_matrix.xlsx (stub)

Thanks —
Ben Carter

- Invoicing cadence: 25/25/25/25 works for us. Please ensure invoice descriptions include the order form ID and a line showing applied credits.

Looping in our finance/legal notes for the thread so we have an agreed position to send to TerraGrid: 

- Net terms: Legal ok with Net 45 for pilot. Finance requests that invoices include a clear "Order Form ID" and the breakdown of prepaid tranches vs consumption credits.
- PO per invoice: Acceptable, but request we add a short clause stating Redwood reserves right to pause delivery if invoice is >60 days overdue (standard). Suggest softening to "suspend new provisioning" rather than termination.
- Tax evidence: Request AP to upload W-9/Local VAT cert to our secure S3 link. We should add a short Exhibit listing evidence required by jurisdiction — I used the attached matrix to populate the exhibit.
- Credits application: Finance prefers credits be netted on the invoice (single-line credit) rather than separate credit memos for easier reconciliation.

Recommended reply to TerraGrid (we're aligned on Net 45 and 25/25/25/25 cadence): Confirm these points and ask for PO window and ETA for W-9. If AP will provide PO number at invoice creation time that's ideal.

If you want, Ben, I can add the 60-day suspension language and a single-line credit clause to the clean order form prior to DocuSign. Also recommend we add a DocuSign checkbox for "requires PO" so AP acknowledges the flow.

-Kimberly
